title: The reply and question card
purpose: What shows a reply or a question, alone on a neutral page. The folded reply card of the bar layout (FoldedCard in registry/app-shell/agent-layer.tsx) is INTERNAL and not exported, so it is not rendered here: this mounts the closest exported things, PiChat's message list (a reply with its file chip) with the question card (pi-chat-question QuestionCard, one question and a form) and the stand-alone InlineQuestion. The composer is hidden (renderComposer) so the card is alone.

fixture.install: npx shadcn@4.23.0 add pi-chat pi-chat-markdown pi-chat-question inline-question
fixture.usage: <PiChat controller={controller} locale="en" header={false} renderText={markdownText} cards={{ question: QuestionCard }} actions={{ answer }} fileChanges onOpenFile={open} renderComposer={() => null} />

notes: A question must show its choices as one-tap buttons of at least 44 px on a phone; once answered the choices give way to the answer and the card keeps its place; a reply's file chip is a real button that opens the file.

steps.expect: The choices give way to my answer, in the same place.
The agent's reply follows under my answer.
My words replace the question's controls.

flows.name: Open the file of a reply

steps.expect: The host is told to open the file.

steps.say: Go to the next reply or file of the conversation
steps.gap: A reply offers its file chip and nothing to move to the next or previous reply: no such control exists in the kit.

steps.expect: The form gives way to the answers, question by question.
